outline: The objectives of this course are to give an overview about different aspects of business intelligence (BI) as well as the methodologies of conducting data mining. The focus of this course will be theory and application oriented and therefore how to use related techniques in handling real world problems based on theory is a must in this course.  Students are required to use relevant data mining techniques in handling real world problems in their final projects.
